# loading and creating dataset for modeling
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source('scripts/preprocessing.R')
```

# assigning the indicators to global variables.
# TTC and Speed_TTC
```{r,include=FALSE}
Dat.SE <- se_ttc
Dat.CN <- cn_ttc_a
x0_1 <- 0
x0_2 <- 0
source("scripts/global_vars.R")
```


# BPOT approach
## BPOT gumbel
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
log_r1 <- run_single_bpot(Dat.CN, model = "log", thres = c(u1, v1),
                          xcrash = x0_1)
log_r2 <- run_single_bpot(Dat.SE, model = "log", thres = c(u2, v2),
                          xcrash = x0_2)
logistic_result <- create_result_bpot(log_r1, log_r2)

gof_bpot(logistic_result$M_1, Dat.CN)
gof_bpot(logistic_result$M_2, Dat.SE)

tbevd_plot(logistic_result$M_1, dat = Dat.CN)
tbevd_plot(logistic_result$M_2, dat = Dat.SE)

plot_crash_severity_single(logistic_result$plot_df_1, injury_df)
plot_crash_severity(logistic_result$plot_df_1, logistic_result$plot_df_2,
                    injury_df)

summarise_bpot(logistic_result, severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1)

sen_log1 <- bpot_theoretical_density(c(0.6, 0.8), log_r1,
                                     filename = "CN_log.csv")
sen_log2 <- bpot_theoretical_density(c(0.6, 0.8), log_r2,
                                     filename = "SE_log.csv")

plot_theoretical_density(sen_log1,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: logistic BEVD CN")
plot_theoretical_density(sen_log2,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: logistic BEVD SE")
```

# CBPOT approach
## CBPOT gumbel
```{r,echo=FALSE}
gum_r1 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_1, copula = gumbelCopula(),
                           p2 = conseq_1, qcrash = qcrash_1, pot = pot_1,
                           method = "mpl")
gum_r2 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_2,
                           copula = rotCopula(gumbelCopula(),
                                              flip = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
                           p2 = conseq_2, qcrash = qcrash_2, pot = pot_2,
                           method = "mpl")
gumbel_result <- create_result_cbpot(gum_r1, gum_r2)

gof.1 <- gofCopula(gumbel_result$Cop_1@copula, cop_dat_1,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "mpl",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
gof.2 <- gofCopula(gumbel_result$Cop_2@copula, cop_dat_2,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "mpl",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
cat("gumbel dependence: GoF CN:", "test statistics", gof.1$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.1$p.value, "\n")
cat("gumbel dependence: GoF SE:", "test statistics", gof.2$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.2$p.value, "\n")

plot_crash_severity_single(gumbel_result$plot_df_q_1, injury_df)
plot_crash_severity(gumbel_result$plot_df_q_1, gumbel_result$plot_df_q_2,
                    injury_df)

summarise_cbpot(gumbel_result, severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1,
                pot_1 = pot_1, pot_2 = pot_2,
                conseq_1 = conseq_1, conseq_2 = conseq_2)

sen_gumbel1 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(1, 1.2, 1.4), "gumbel",
                                       gum_r1, filename = "CN_gumbel.csv")
sen_gumbel2 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(1, 1.2, 1.4), "gumbel",
                                       gum_r2, filename = "SE_gumbel.csv")

plot_theoretical_density(sen_gumbel1,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Gumbel Copula CN")
plot_theoretical_density(sen_gumbel2,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Gumbel Copula SE")

```

## CBPOT Clayton

```{r,echo=FALSE}
clay_r1 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_1, copula = claytonCopula(),
                            p2 = conseq_1, qcrash = qcrash_1, pot = pot_1)
clay_r2 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_2,
                            copula = rotCopula(claytonCopula(),
                                               flip = c(TRUE, FALSE)),
                            p2 = conseq_2, qcrash = qcrash_2, pot = pot_2)
clayton_result <- create_result_cbpot(clay_r1, clay_r2)

gof.1 <- gofCopula(clayton_result$Cop_1@copula, cop_dat_1,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "itau",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
gof.2 <- gofCopula(clayton_result$Cop_2@copula, cop_dat_2,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "itau",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
cat("clayton dependence: GoF CN:", "test statistics", gof.1$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.1$p.value, "\n")
cat("clayton dependence: GoF SE:", "test statistics", gof.2$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.2$p.value, "\n")

plot_crash_severity_single(clayton_result$plot_df_q_1, injury_df)
plot_crash_severity(clayton_result$plot_df_q_1,
                    clayton_result$plot_df_q_2, injury_df)

summarise_cbpot(clayton_result, severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1,
                pot_1 = pot_1, pot_2 = pot_2,
                conseq_1 = conseq_1, conseq_2 = conseq_2)

sen_clay1 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(1, 2, 4), "clayton",
                                       clay_r1, filename = "CN_clayton.csv")
sen_clay2 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(1, 2, 4), "clayton",
                                       clay_r2, filename = "SE_clayton.csv")

plot_theoretical_density(sen_clay1,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Clayton Copula CN")
plot_theoretical_density(sen_clay2,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Clayton Copula SE")
```

## CBPOT Gaussian
```{r,echo=FALSE}
norm_r1 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_1,
                            copula = normalCopula(param = -0.1,
                                                  dispstr = "ex"),
                            p2 = conseq_1, qcrash = qcrash_1, pot = pot_1,
                            method = "mpl")
norm_r2 <- run_single_cbpot(cop_dat_2,
                            copula = normalCopula(param = 0.1,
                                                  dispstr = "ex"),
                            p2 = conseq_2, qcrash = qcrash_2, pot = pot_2,
                            method = "mpl")
normal_result <- create_result_cbpot(norm_r1, norm_r2)

gof.1 <- gofCopula(normal_result$Cop_1@copula, cop_dat_1,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "itau",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
gof.2 <- gofCopula(normal_result$Cop_2@copula, cop_dat_2,
                   method = "Sn", estim.method = "itau",
                   verbose = FALSE, N = 1000)
cat("normal dependence: GoF CN:", "test statistics", gof.1$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.1$p.value, "\n")
cat("normal dependence: GoF SE:", "test statistics", gof.2$statistic,
    "p-value", gof.2$p.value, "\n")

plot_crash_severity_single(normal_result$plot_df_q_1, injury_df)
plot_crash_severity(normal_result$plot_df_q_1,
                    normal_result$plot_df_q_2, injury_df)

summarise_cbpot(normal_result, severity = pis0, severity_age = pis1,
                pot_1 = pot_1, pot_2 = pot_2,
                conseq_1 = conseq_1, conseq_2 = conseq_2)

sen_norm1 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(-0.3, 0, 0.3), "normal",
                                       norm_r1, filename = "CN_normal.csv")
sen_norm2 <- cbpot_theoretical_density(c(-0.3, 0, 0.3), "normal",
                                       norm_r2, filename = "SE_normal.csv")

plot_theoretical_density(sen_norm1,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Normal Copula CN")
plot_theoretical_density(sen_norm2,
                         title = "theoretical density of crash severity: Normal Copula SE")
```
